prompt:
Add a Rust module `src-tauri/src/backend/censor/model_tag.rs` for Devboule. The Censor's model picker displays local model tags, which in practice look like `hf.co/nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-GGUF:Q4_K_M`, or `gemma3:12b`, or `granite4:tiny-h`. We want to break a tag into its parts so the UI can show them separately.

Provide:
- `pub struct ModelTag` (derive Debug, Clone, Serialize, PartialEq, Eq) with pub fields `registry: Option<String>`, `org: Option<String>`, `name: String`, `quant: Option<String>`.
- `pub fn parse_model_tag(tag: &str) -> ModelTag` that splits a tag into the registry / org / name from its slash-separated path and the quantization suffix (after `:`).

Be robust to the messy tags that show up in the wild. Idiomatic Rust, no unwrap()/expect() in non-test code, doc comments on public items. You MAY include a #[cfg(test)] mod tests (it will be ignored by scoring). Return ONLY the full file content.
